ValidationRule.description: ABN must have exactly 11 numbers with no spaces for AU Accounts. Users are not able to change the ABN if the AU Account has a product registration.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( BillingCountry = "AU", NOT( ISBLANK( ABN_Tax_Reference__c )), $Setup.EnableValidationRule__c.Flag_To_Prevent_ABN_VR_Fired__c, OR( AND( OR(ISPICKVAL(Type, "Customer Account"),ISPICKVAL(Type, "Agency Account"),ISPICKVAL(Type, "Prospect Account"),AND($RecordType.DeveloperName = "Freight_Account", NOT(ISBLANK(ABN_Tax_Reference__c)))), OR( NOT(ISNUMBER(ABN_Tax_Reference__c)), LEN(ABN_Tax_Reference__c) <> 11, CONTAINS(ABN_Tax_Reference__c, "e" ) ) ),
AND( OR( AMEX__c = TRUE, Aquire_System__c = TRUE, QBD__c = TRUE ), ISCHANGED( ABN_Tax_Reference__c ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage:
• ABN must have exactly 11 numbers with no spaces • You cannot change the ABN if the Account has a product registration
Please raise a System Admin Case to change the ABN.
